content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect handling of the Quality of Protection (QOP) settings in the RPC (Remote Procedure Call) mechanism using SASL (Simple Authentication and Security Layer). Specifically, the negotiated QOP was not being properly retrieved and utilized, leading to potential security vulnerabilities and improper authentication behavior. The patch introduced changes to ensure that the negotiated QOP is correctly set and used in both the client and server implementations, thereby fixing the broken SASL QOP functionality.
